In my job, people always ask me the same question: when can we start? My answer is always the same: not before the contract is signed. The process has four steps. First, one side sends the draft. Then the lawyers of the other side review it and send their comments. This can take two or three rounds. Once both teams agree on every clause, the managers sign off. And only when the signatures are on the contract, the project can begin. My advice is simple. Send the draft early, and answer the comments quickly. If you wait until the last day, you will lose a week, maybe two.

Hello everyone, this is Raj, the project manager for the hospital rollout. Let me explain the plan for the first month. As soon as we receive the purchase order, I will book the kick-off meeting. Before we visit the first hospital, our engineers will finish the site survey report. Once the hospital approves the design, we will order the cameras. The first milestone is the main building, and we will finish it by the end of March. After that, we will roll out the system in the other three buildings, one at a time. I will send a short update every Friday until the project is complete.

Luciana, congratulations on the new contract. I am really happy for your team. Now, a small idea for the next months. When the project starts, the hospital will watch every detail, so the first milestone is very important. If it goes well, people will talk about you. And there is something else. Our group is preparing a similar project for two hospitals in Munich. As soon as your first phase is ready, I would like to bring our director to São Paulo to see it. Before we plan the visit, could you send me the dates of the first milestone? Once I have them, I will talk to him.
